profile.jobTitle: Web Designer, Front-End Web Developer, Graphic Designer
profile.summary:
As a web developer at Kerigan Marketing Associates, Inc., I applied my knowledge and skills in web development, search engine optimization, and digital media to create engaging content, improved Google rankings, and assisted building websites for various clients. I have over three years of experience in this field, including one year as a web development intern and one year as a junior web developer at the same company.

I am passionate about learning new technologies and trends in web development, and I enjoy working with a talented and supportive team. I am also a freelance web designer and developer, where I provide personalized and creative solutions for individuals and businesses. 

My goal is to continue to grow and excel as a web developer, and to eventually pursue a master's degree in this field.

volunteerExperiences.description: While I went on search and rescue missions to locate downed aircraft or respond to vessel-based emergency beacons to identify need-based assistance, my main duties were to train and prepare individuals to participate in various Emergency Services missions (first aid, navigation, extraction, etc).  I spent a great deal of time working with the State of Florida Emergency Response Team during the 2004 hurricane season in multiple roles to facilitate communication between our two agencies and our search and rescue activities.  Another notable aspect to my service with the CAP, was that I and a couple of our Squadron members were deployed to South Florida after Hurricane Charlie went through and assisted with setting up communications, damage assessment, and more.  I would describe my time with the Civil Air Patrol as not only a personal development exercise, but also a direct opportunity to assist those in need and assist in ensuring their safety.

projects.title: Gulf Coast State College Center For Student Media Website
projects.description: Recognizing the need for an "umbrella" to bring the various Gulf Coast State College Digital Media program   web sites together, I was asked to create a site that would meet the need.  The idea was to have a singular landing point for visitors to see what made up the Center For Student Media.  The site is also meant to act as a representation of the student participants and their work.  This site is currently under development and is expected to go live within the first quarter of 2020.

projects.title: The Omni Review Website
projects.description: The redesign and development of the Gulf Coast State College Literary Journal.  The project originally began prior to Hurricane Michael (Oct. 10, 2018) and was temporarily put on hold as the community began the re-building process.  The project has resumed is anticipated to be completed by the end of July 2019.
